name: header
description: Trace header frame. REQUIRED, exactly once, first frame in every .sb file. See spec/sbtrace-v1.md §6.1.

fields.name: format_version
fields.description: Wire-format major version. 1 in v1; 2 in v2.

fields.name: recorder_version
fields.description: SemVer of the recorder library that wrote the trace.

fields.name: public_key
fields.description: 64 hex chars: Ed25519 public key whose private half signed every frame.

fields.name: hmac_key_id
fields.description: First 16 hex chars of SHA256(hmac_key). Identifies the key without revealing it.

fields.name: price_list_version
fields.description: Pinned cost-model version used to compute step cost_usd.

fields.name: wallclock_ns
fields.description: Recorder wall-clock at trace open, ns since Unix epoch.

fields.name: compression
fields.description: Trace-level compression scheme tag. Optional for forward compatibility; absent ≡ 'none'.

fields.name: blob_threshold
fields.description: Min canonical-JSON byte size considered for blob interning. Optional; absent ≡ 0.

fields.name: blob_min_reuse
fields.description: Min reuse count for a sub-tree to be interned. Optional; absent ≡ 0.

fields.name: semantic_hash_version
fields.description: Semantic-hash function version. v2-only; absent in v1 headers.

fields.name: wire_encodings
fields.description: Ordered list of every encoding the trace may carry. v2-only.

extension_ranges.description: Reserved for the SB-Trace spec. New core header fields require a wire-format minor or major bump.
Header fields contributed by a registered capability (e.g. 'attestation.witness' could allocate ids in this range).
Vendor-private header fields. Readers MUST ignore unknown ones; writers SHOULD declare an advisory capability frame to document them.
Reserved for future major versions of the header.
